summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for Bepari covering persistent device login & database settings sync, BIN preservation on non-Mushak memos, P.O No / Challan No / Challan Date support, footer slogan/description/multi-brand logos, independent System UI vs Document Print language, configurable product attribute display (Brand, Size, Color, Description), CSV & Excel copy-paste bulk import for Products & Customers, a top-level Quotation module with 1-click Invoice conversion, and 1-click Delivery Challan generation.
